description: Monthly revenue and downloads for any App Store app, worldwide: one figure each (`value`, or `under` when the app is below that amount) and how many markets it covers. Every app gets an answer. Hive already knows them. The first request for an app starts the read and answers `status: "pending"` with `eta` in seconds; call again after that. 500 credits for the figures; a pending answer is 1.

country.description: storefront the read starts from, e.g. us (defaults to us)

name: hive_estimate
